entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, hello. I'm a bit lost. I ordered a jersey a while ago, and it's just not right. I think I got the wrong size.
I can certainly look into that for you. To clarify, is there a technical fault with the item, or is it more of a preference issue with the fit?

Oh, um, a preference I guess? It's just... way too tight. I don't understand the sizing chart on the website, it's all very confusing. I was hoping to do an exchange for a different size. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I can help. I just need to ask a few questions to find the best solution. Can you provide me with the order number, please?
Thank you. Let me pull that up. I see the order for the Men's Pro-Line Jersey, delivered on November 10th. That was 31 days ago.
Oh dear, is that too long? I'm so sorry, I just got overwhelmed with things. I didn't understand the policy.

No need to worry. Let me just check our current policy for you. One moment... Okay, I've confirmed it. Since your jersey is a standard VeloFit item, it falls under our 90-day return window. You're well within the timeframe.
Oh, really? That's such a relief! So I can return it?

Absolutely. We can process this as an exchange for the correct size or a full return, whichever you prefer. I've just initiated the process and you will receive an email with a prepaid shipping label within the next 15 minutes.
Thank you so much, Diana! You've been a great help. I really appreciate you making that so easy.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
Nope, that's everything. Thank you again!
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
